title: Folded gate evaluation
statement: For every gate kind $k$, argument list $a$, and Boolean value list $v$, folding the gate’s accumulator update over the arguments, starting from its prescribed initial accumulator and then applying its final adjustment, gives the value of the gate of kind $k$ on arguments $a$ with values read from $v$ (using false when an index is out of range).
hypotheses_covered: An arbitrary list of argument indices
An arbitrary list of Boolean values
